data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Armilla was a goddess of armor. Her name means 'soldier's armor'. She protected warriors in battle and granted them strength and courage. In Christianity, the name Armilla can symbolize spiritual armor, reminding us to put on the whole armor of God to stand against the enemy. The name Armilla carries the meaning “Soldier's armor” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Armilla usually hope their child will grow to embody soldier's armor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
